top_signals.title: Technology Stocks Lift Equities as Treasuries Rise: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Technology stocks lifted global equities after stellar revenue growth at Anthropic PBC bolstered the view that massive spending on artificial intelligence will be sustained. Treasuries gained as oil prices fell.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Chinese Steel Production Tumbles as Economic Conditions Worsen
top_signals.summary: Chinese steel production tumbled last month, putting the industry on track for the lowest annual total this decade as mills adjust to much weaker demand.
